{"schema":"chronicle.historical-narrative","version":"0.1","paragraphs":[{"id":"para_early","phase_id":"p_early","segments":[{"text":"周瑜字公瑾，是庐江舒人，身材高大、相貌出众。父亲周异做过洛阳令，从祖父周景及周景之子周忠都曾任汉太尉。孙坚参加讨伐董卓的义军时，把家眷迁到舒；孙策与周瑜同年，二人尤其要好，周瑜还让出道南大宅给孙策居住，彼此互通有无。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_001","added_friendship"],"event_id":"event_025","event_relation":"background","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_042","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_041","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_013","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_visit","phase_id":"p_visit","segments":[{"text":"周瑜的从父周尚任丹杨太守，周瑜前往探望他。","conclusion_ids":["added_visit"],"event_id":null,"event_relation":null,"event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_053","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_080","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_east","phase_id":"p_east","segments":[{"text":"孙策准备渡江向东，到了历阳便派人通知周瑜，周瑜带兵前去迎接。随后他随孙策攻取横江、当利，在秣陵击败笮融和薛礼，又攻下湖孰、江乘，进军曲阿。刘繇败走，孙策部众增至数万人；孙策认为凭这些兵力足以攻取吴会、平定山越，便让周瑜返回丹杨驻守。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_002","added_sunshang_office","added_sunce_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_013","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_042","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_077","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_061","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_084","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_shouchun","phase_id":"p_shouchun","segments":[{"text":"周瑜还镇丹杨不久，袁术派从弟袁胤代周尚为丹杨太守，周瑜与周尚一同回到寿春。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_003"],"event_id":"event_019","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_020","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_053","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_028","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_juchao","phase_id":"p_juchao","segments":[{"text":"袁术想让周瑜做将领，周瑜认为袁术最终不会有所成就，便请求担任居巢长，打算借道东归，袁术答应了。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_004"],"event_id":"event_010","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_028","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_034","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_087","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_return","phase_id":"p_return","segments":[{"text":"建安三年，周瑜从居巢回到吴地。孙策亲自迎接，授他建威中郎将，给兵二千、骑五十。周瑜当时二十四岁，吴地人称他为“周郎”。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_005","added_sunce_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_020","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_042","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_067","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_030","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_niuzhu","phase_id":"p_niuzhu","segments":[{"text":"周瑜在庐江素有恩信，于是被派出镇守牛渚。","conclusion_ids":["added_niuzhu","added_sunce_allegiance"],"event_id":null,"event_relation":null,"event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_052","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_030","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_chungu","phase_id":"p_chungu","segments":[{"text":"出镇牛渚以后，周瑜领春谷长。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_006","added_sunce_allegiance"],"event_id":null,"event_relation":null,"event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_099","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_042","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_wan","phase_id":"p_wan","segments":[{"text":"孙策准备进取荆州，任命周瑜为中护军。周瑜随孙策攻克皖；此后又到寻阳附近击败刘勋，进讨江夏，返回平定豫章、庐陵，留下镇守巴丘。这一时期的底本在任中护军后紧接写有“領導江夏太守”，可能还涉及兼领江夏太守，但文字有疑；裴松之又指出，当时孙策尚未定江夏。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_007","conclusion_008","added_wan_campaign","added_sunce_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_014","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_042","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_089","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_090","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_007","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_003","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_sunquan","phase_id":"p_sunquan","segments":[{"text":"建安五年孙策去世，孙权接掌政事。周瑜率兵赶去奔丧，随后留在吴，以中护军身份与长史张昭共同掌管众事。此时周瑜对孙权恪守臣礼，明确在孙权麾下掌事。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_009","conclusion_010","added_zhangzhao_office","added_sunquan_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_023","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_057","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_040","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_hostage","phase_id":"p_hostage","segments":[{"text":"据《江表传》，建安七年曹操要求孙权送子弟为人质。周瑜认为，一旦送质，孙权便会受曹氏制约，不如守住父兄留下的基业、静观局势。孙权的母亲赞同周瑜，劝孙权像对待兄长一样对待他，孙权于是没有送质。","conclusion_ids":["added_hostage"],"event_id":null,"event_relation":null,"event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_057","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_043","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_206","phase_id":"p_206","segments":[{"text":"建安十一年，周瑜督率孙瑜等讨伐麻、保二屯，斩其首领并俘获一万余人。随后，江夏太守黄祖派邓龙率数千人进入柴桑，周瑜追击并生擒邓龙，送往吴地。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_011","conclusion_012","added_huangzu_office"],"event_id":"event_012","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_060","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_046","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_050","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_spring","phase_id":"p_spring","segments":[{"text":"建安十三年春，孙权进攻江夏，周瑜担任前部大督。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_013","added_sunquan_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_004","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_057","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_007","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_jingzhou","phase_id":"p_jingzhou","segments":[{"text":"同年九月，曹操进入荆州，刘琮率众投降。曹操取得刘表的水军，水陆兵力号称数十万，孙权部下听说后十分恐惧。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_014"],"event_id":"event_015","event_relation":"background","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_043","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_010","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_004","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_decision","phase_id":"p_decision","segments":[{"text":"孙权召集部属问计，群臣认为曹操借汉廷名义征伐，又得到荆州水军，长江之险已不足独恃，主张迎降。周瑜反对，指出曹操北方未稳，马超、韩遂仍在关西；北军不长于水战，严寒中马缺饲草，远来将士也容易因水土不服患病。他请求精兵三万人进驻夏口，迎击曹军。孙权赞同周瑜的意见。裴松之认为，抗曹之计实际先由鲁肃提出；本传虽集中记载周瑜的抗战主张，却不能据此否定鲁肃此前的谋划。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_015","conclusion_016","conclusion_017","added_caocao_title","added_jiangdong_control","added_sunquan_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_007","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_057","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_043","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_001","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_058","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_redcliff","phase_id":"p_redcliff","segments":[{"text":"刘备被曹操击败后，在当阳与鲁肃相遇，共同商议对策，随后进驻夏口，派诸葛亮前去拜见孙权。孙权于是派周瑜、程普等与刘备合力迎战曹操，在赤壁相遇。曹军已有疾病，初战失利后退驻江北，周瑜等在南岸。黄盖认为敌众我寡、难以持久，见曹军船舰首尾相接，便建议火攻。他备下装有柴草、浇过油脂的战船，覆帷幕、建旗号，先致书曹操诈降，又把轻便小船系在大船后。曹军以为黄盖来降，黄盖纵火，烈风将火势带到岸上营寨，烟焰冲天，曹军人马烧死、溺死者甚多，遂败退。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_018","conclusion_019","added_huanggai_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_002","event_relation":"current","event_text":"赤壁"}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_043","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_008","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_001","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_037","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_039","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_retreat","phase_id":"p_retreat","segments":[{"text":"曹军败退后退保南郡，刘备与周瑜等继续追击；曹操留下曹仁等守江陵城，自己向北撤回。此时江陵城由曹操留下的曹仁等守卫。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_020","added_caoren_allegiance","added_jiangling_before"],"event_id":"event_003","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_043","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_014","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_097","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_008","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_nan_battle","phase_id":"p_nan_battle","segments":[{"text":"周瑜、程普继续进军南郡，与曹仁隔江对峙。周瑜先派甘宁据守夷陵，曹仁分兵围攻，甘宁告急。周瑜采纳吕蒙之计，留下凌统守后方，自己与吕蒙救援甘宁。解围后，周瑜渡江屯在北岸，约定日期交战。他在交战中被流箭射中右胁，曹仁听闻其卧病后进逼军阵；周瑜起身巡视军营、激励将士，曹仁因此退兵。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_021","conclusion_022","added_caoren_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_011","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_014","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_022","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_029","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_024","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_nan_office","phase_id":"p_nan_office","segments":[{"text":"南郡战事后，孙权任命周瑜为偏将军，领南郡太守，并使其屯据江陵；下雋、汉昌、刘阳、州陵被列为其奉邑。周瑜领南郡太守、刘备到京见孙权这一时期，刘备以左将军身份兼领荆州牧，以公安为治所。周瑜还上疏建议把刘备安置在吴，以宫室、美人和玩好牵住他，再把关羽、张飞分置别处；孙权没有采纳。江陵在这一阶段由周瑜军屯据。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_023","conclusion_024","conclusion_025","conclusion_026","added_liubei_left","added_liubei_jing","added_sunquan_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_027","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_097","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_008","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_035","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_023","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_shu_plan","phase_id":"p_shu_plan","segments":[{"text":"提出取蜀计划时，刘璋任益州牧，益州又受到张鲁侵扰。周瑜到京见孙权，认为曹操新败、正忧心内部，提出与称作“奋威”的将领共同进取蜀地，再兼并张鲁，留奋威守蜀、与马超结援；自己回来后与孙权据襄阳逼迫曹操，进图北方。孙权同意了这个方略。这里记载的是提议与许可，并未记作已经攻取益州。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_027","conclusion_028","conclusion_023","conclusion_024","added_yizhou_admin","added_sunquan_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_001","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_002","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_085","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_032","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_071","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_058","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_death","phase_id":"p_death","segments":[{"text":"周瑜返回江陵准备行装，途经巴丘时病逝，终年三十六岁。裴松之认为，病卒的巴丘应在他所说的巴陵，与周瑜早年镇守的巴丘同名而异地。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_029","added_baqiu"],"event_id":"event_018","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_086","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_088","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_mourning","phase_id":"p_mourning","segments":[{"text":"孙权穿素服为周瑜举哀，并在灵柩运回吴地途中到芜湖迎接，丧事所需费用由其供给。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_030"],"event_id":"event_028","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_057","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_089","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_recollection","phase_id":"p_recollection","segments":[{"text":"周瑜性情宽宏，大多能得到人心，早先与程普关系不睦。《江表传》说，程普仗着年长屡次凌辱周瑜，周瑜谦让而不计较，程普后来敬服他，说与周公瑾交往如饮醇酒，不知不觉便醉了。另据《江表传》，曹操派蒋干拜访周瑜，周瑜以自己与知己之主的君臣、骨肉之恩相答，蒋干最终未能游说，回去后称赞周瑜气度高远。周瑜年轻时还精于音乐，即使饮酒后也能听出演奏差错，因此有“曲有误，周郎顾”的歌谣。","conclusion_ids":["added_personality","added_jianggan","added_music"],"event_id":"event_017","event_relation":"background","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_017","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_009","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_family","phase_id":"p_family","segments":[{"text":"周瑜有两个儿子和一个女儿，女儿嫁给太子孙登，长子周循娶了公主。","conclusion_ids":["added_children"],"event_id":null,"event_relation":null,"event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_045","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_049","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_054","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_xun","phase_id":"p_xun","segments":[{"text":"周循获任骑都尉，颇有周瑜的风范。","conclusion_ids":["added_xun_office"],"event_id":"event_006","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_049","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_059","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_xun_death","phase_id":"p_xun_death","segments":[{"text":"周循早逝。","conclusion_ids":["added_xun_death"],"event_id":null,"event_relation":null,"event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_049","importance":"primary"}]},{"id":"para_yin_initial","phase_id":"p_yin_initial","segments":[{"text":"周胤起初拜兴业都尉，娶宗室女子为妻，获授一千名士兵并屯驻公安。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_031"],"event_id":null,"event_relation":null,"event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_054","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_088","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_076","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_yin_title","phase_id":"p_yin_title","segments":[{"text":"黄龙元年，周胤受封都乡侯。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_032"],"event_id":"event_024","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_054","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_075","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_yin_exile","phase_id":"p_yin_exile","segments":[{"text":"周胤受封以后，因罪被迁到庐陵郡。","conclusion_ids":["added_yin_exile"],"event_id":null,"event_relation":null,"event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_054","importance":"primary"}]},{"id":"para_yin_petition","phase_id":"p_yin_petition","segments":[{"text":"赤乌二年，诸葛瑾、步骘联名上疏，请孙权顾念周瑜冒矢石、击败曹操和曹仁的功劳，宽免周胤，恢复兵权与爵位。他们援引汉高祖封爵誓言，主张功臣后裔也应得到照顾。孙权答复说并未忘记周瑜，只因周胤屡经告诫仍不改过，暂不愿立即恢复；奏疏则称周胤已经“降为匹夫”。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_033","added_yin_loss"],"event_id":"event_016","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_054","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_015","importance":"other"},{"entity_id": ents":[{"text":"同年九月，曹操进入荆州，刘琮率众投降。曹操取得刘表的水军，水陆兵力号称数十万，孙权部下听说后十分恐惧。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_014"],"event_id":"event_015","event_relation":"background","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_043","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_010","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_004","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_decision","phase_id":"p_decision","segments":[{"text":"孙权召集部属问计，群臣认为曹操借汉廷名义征伐，又得到荆州水军，长江之险已不足独恃，主张迎降。周瑜反对，指出曹操北方未稳，马超、韩遂仍在关西；北军不长于水战，严寒中马缺饲草，远来将士也容易因水土不服患病。他请求精兵三万人进驻夏口，迎击曹军。孙权赞同周瑜的意见。裴松之认为，抗曹之计实际先由鲁肃提出；本传虽集中记载周瑜的抗战主张，却不能据此否定鲁肃此前的谋划。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_015","conclusion_016","conclusion_017","added_caocao_title","added_jiangdong_control","added_sunquan_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_007","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_057","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_043","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_001","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_058","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_redcliff_intro","phase_id":"p_decision","segments":[{"text":"刘备被曹操击败后，在当阳与鲁肃相遇，共同商议对策，随后进驻夏口，派诸葛亮前去拜见孙权。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_018"],"event_id":"event_008","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_008","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_001","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_037","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_055","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_redcliff","phase_id":"p_redcliff","segments":[{"text":"孙权于是派周瑜、程普等与刘备合力迎战曹操，在赤壁相遇。曹军已有疾病，初战失利后退驻江北，周瑜等在南岸。黄盖认为敌众我寡、难以持久，见曹军船舰首尾相接，便建议火攻。他备下装有柴草、浇过油脂的战船，覆帷幕、建旗号，先致书曹操诈降，又把轻便小船系在大船后。曹军以为黄盖来降，黄盖纵火，烈风将火势带到岸上营寨，烟焰冲天，曹军人马烧死、溺死者甚多，遂败退。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_019","added_huanggai_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_002","event_relation":"current","event_text":"赤壁"}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_043","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_008","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_001","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_037","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_039","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_retreat","phase_id":"p_retreat","segments":[{"text":"曹军败退后退保南郡，刘备与周瑜等继续追击；曹操留下曹仁等守江陵城，自己向北撤回。此时江陵城由曹操留下的曹仁等守卫。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_020","added_caoren_allegiance","added_jiangling_before"],"event_id":"event_003","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_043","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_014","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_097","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_008","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_nan_battle","phase_id":"p_nan_battle","segments":[{"text":"周瑜、程普继续进军南郡，与曹仁隔江对峙。周瑜先派甘宁据守夷陵，曹仁分兵围攻，甘宁告急。周瑜采纳吕蒙之计，留下凌统守后方，自己与吕蒙救援甘宁。解围后，周瑜渡江屯在北岸，约定日期交战。他在交战中被流箭射中右胁，曹仁听闻其卧病后进逼军阵；周瑜起身巡视军营、激励将士，曹仁因此退兵。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_021","conclusion_022","added_caoren_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_011","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_014","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_022","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_029","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_024","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_nan_office","phase_id":"p_nan_office","segments":[{"text":"南郡战事后，孙权任命周瑜为偏将军，领南郡太守，并使其屯据江陵；下雋、汉昌、刘阳、州陵被列为其奉邑。周瑜领南郡太守、刘备到京见孙权这一时期，刘备以左将军身份兼领荆州牧，以公安为治所。周瑜还上疏建议把刘备安置在吴，以宫室、美人和玩好牵住他，再把关羽、张飞分置别处；孙权没有采纳。江陵在这一阶段由周瑜军屯据。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_023","conclusion_024","conclusion_025","conclusion_026","added_liubei_left","added_liubei_jing","added_sunquan_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_027","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_097","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_008","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_035","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_023","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_shu_plan","phase_id":"p_shu_plan","segments":[{"text":"提出取蜀计划时，刘璋任益州牧，益州又受到张鲁侵扰。周瑜到京见孙权，认为曹操新败、正忧心内部，提出与称作“奋威”的将领共同进取蜀地，再兼并张鲁，留奋威守蜀、与马超结援；自己回来后与孙权据襄阳逼迫曹操，进图北方。孙权同意了这个方略。这里记载的是提议与许可，并未记作已经攻取益州。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_027","conclusion_028","conclusion_023","conclusion_024","added_yizhou_admin","added_sunquan_allegiance"],"event_id":"event_001","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_002","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_085","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_032","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_071","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_058","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_death","phase_id":"p_death","segments":[{"text":"周瑜返回江陵准备行装，途经巴丘时病逝，终年三十六岁。裴松之认为，病卒的巴丘应在他所说的巴陵，与周瑜早年镇守的巴丘同名而异地。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_029","added_baqiu"],"event_id":"event_018","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_086","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_088","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_mourning","phase_id":"p_mourning","segments":[{"text":"孙权穿素服为周瑜举哀，并在灵柩运回吴地途中到芜湖迎接，丧事所需费用由其供给。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_030"],"event_id":"event_028","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_057","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_089","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_recollection","phase_id":"p_recollection","segments":[{"text":"周瑜性情宽宏，大多能得到人心，早先与程普关系不睦。《江表传》说，程普仗着年长屡次凌辱周瑜，周瑜谦让而不计较，程普后来敬服他，说与周公瑾交往如饮醇酒，不知不觉便醉了。另据《江表传》，曹操派蒋干拜访周瑜，周瑜以自己与知己之主的君臣、骨肉之恩相答，蒋干最终未能游说，回去后称赞周瑜气度高远。周瑜年轻时还精于音乐，即使饮酒后也能听出演奏差错，因此有“曲有误，周郎顾”的歌谣。","conclusion_ids":["added_personality","added_jianggan","added_music"],"event_id":"event_017","event_relation":"background","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_017","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_009","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_family","phase_id":"p_family","segments":[{"text":"周瑜有两个儿子和一个女儿，女儿嫁给太子孙登，长子周循娶了公主。","conclusion_ids":["added_children"],"event_id":null,"event_relation":null,"event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_045","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_049","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_054","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_xun","phase_id":"p_xun","segments":[{"text":"周循获任骑都尉，颇有周瑜的风范。","conclusion_ids":["added_xun_office"],"event_id":"event_006","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_049","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_059","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_006","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_xun_death","phase_id":"p_xun_death","segments":[{"text":"周循早逝。","conclusion_ids":["added_xun_death"],"event_id":null,"event_relation":null,"event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_049","importance":"primary"}]},{"id":"para_yin_initial","phase_id":"p_yin_initial","segments":[{"text":"周胤起初拜兴业都尉，娶宗室女子为妻，获授一千名士兵并屯驻公安。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_031"],"event_id":null,"event_relation":null,"event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_054","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_088","importance":"other"},{"entity_id":"entity_076","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_yin_title","phase_id":"p_yin_title","segments":[{"text":"黄龙元年，周胤受封都乡侯。","conclusion_ids":["conclusion_032"],"event_id":"event_024","event_relation":"current","event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_054","importance":"primary"},{"entity_id":"entity_075","importance":"other"}]},{"id":"para_yin_exile","phase_id":"p_yin_exile","segments":[{"text":"周胤受封以后，因罪被迁到庐陵郡。","conclusion_ids":["added_yin_exile"],"event_id":null,"event_relation":null,"event_text":null}],"entities":[{"entity_id":"entity_054","importance":"primary"}]},{"id":"para_yin_petition","phase_id":"p_yin_petition","segments":[{"text":"
